responsibility: Primary shared header for the C-family front ends, collecting declarations, enums, macros, globals, and helper APIs used across parsing, semantic analysis, diagnostics, preprocessing, and lowering. It defines common reserved-word identifiers, exposes warning and attribute helper entry points implemented in sibling files, declares C-family-specific tree and diagnostic conventions, and serves as the central interface tying together c-common.cc with other c-family subsystems.
same_name_distinction: Central header for shared C-family facilities: it exposes the enums, globals, macros, and function declarations used across the module, in contrast to c-common.cc which implements those services and c-common.def which only declares extra C-family tree codes for generator use.
